# Notifications

The commands `mt help` lists under Notifications.

In a terminal, type `mt` and then the command. In the interactive shell and the cloud shell, type the command on
its own. `mt help <command>` shows the same details in your terminal.

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`notifications`](#notifications) | Watch live updates to runs and knowledge files as they happen, until you stop it (Ctrl+C) |

## notifications

Watch live updates to runs and knowledge files as they happen, until you stop it (Ctrl+C).

```text
mt notifications [type] [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<type>` | text |  | `all` | What to watch: all, app-process, interaction-process, interaction-process-stream, capsule-process, code-pipeline-process, file; interaction-process-stream shows replies as they are written (short names: app, interaction, stream, capsule, code-pipeline) |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--filter <id>` | id |  |  | Only updates about this id: a run's, or a knowledge file's |
